title: shabeehe imaame zamaa'n khainchte hai
body:
shabeehe imaame zamaa'n khainchte hai
tasawwur me tasweere jaa'n khainchte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jagah mol li hai mazaaro'n ki qaatir
shahe dee'n zamee'n par nishaa'n khainchte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab haal hai dukhtare fatima ka
rida sar se eeza rasaa'n khainchte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kahaa'n paaye abid kahaa'n dohri bedi
ye langar kahee'n naatawaa'n khainchte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha roke akbar ne ae dard tham ja
ke seene se baba sina khainchte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pukaari sakina dohaayi hai baba
sitamgar meri baaliyaa'n khainchte hai
